# Quantity

## Summary
Catalog shared field for counted amounts — a NumberField subclass. Lives in
the catalog realm at `fields/quantity/quantity` (default export
`QuantityField`).

## API
Primitive number, intended for unit counts (line-item quantities, stock
levels) as opposed to measurements or money.

## Usage
```ts
import QuantityField from 'https://app.boxel.ai/catalog/fields/quantity/quantity';

@field quantity = contains(QuantityField);
```
The shared-realm Line Item block models the same concern with a plain
NumberField; adopting this field is the catalog-aligned choice when a realm
already consumes catalog fields.
